test: RT-V2-01 camera module, post-FAIL diagnosis (2026-11-04, session 1e8761b1). Original FAIL and criterion preserved unchanged in ../../../2026-11-03-mNLNb-Z4T0M-deep-ct-scan/reconstruction_test/RT-V2-01/EVALUATION.json
instrument: scripts/cam_traj.py: ORB(4000)+BF cross-check, top 1500 matches, RANSAC partial-affine vs window first frame; MEASURED

source_S080.classification: HORIZONTAL PAN (image content moves right ~137.5 px = 7.2% of width), ease-in-out, scale constant within 0.15% (no push-in), vertical drift <0.4 px

source_S088_reference.finding: slow combined push (scale +1.2% over 30 frames) with diagonal drift; a DIFFERENT move type from S080, still moving at f9160; not used for RT-V2-02

render_RT_V2_01.design: render.py: uniform scale 1->1.25 with smoothstep over 16 frames (f100-f115)
render_RT_V2_01.measured: scale 1.0->1.249 by f114; ORB inliers 7-32 on the flat board so f101-104 tracking failed (reported scale 1.0 while pixel diff shows change)
render_RT_V2_01.classification: PUSH-IN; follows the spec it was given

diagnosis.incorrect_reference_measurement: YES: the spec labelled S080 a 'push-in/reframe' from mean_abs_diff alone; mean diff cannot tell scale from translation; magnitude and axis were never measured. Geometric tracking shows a pan.
diagnosis.incorrect_reconstruction: NO for the given spec (worker implemented the stated push with ease); YES relative to the source (wrong move type) as a consequence of the spec error
diagnosis.unsuitable_criterion: YES: absolute mean_abs_diff>0.3 is texture-dependent; the same motion on the source's textured art gives peak 10.2 but on the flat test board 1.4, so first/last moving frames (0.204, 0.165) fall under 0.3 -> 14 counted. Also a flat board defeats geometric tracking, so the test scene itself must be textured.
diagnosis.verdict: COMBINATION: wrong reference measurement (primary defect) + unsuitable criterion + unsuitable flat test scene

fix: RT-V2-02: spec re-derived from geometric trajectory (pan, magnitude, per-frame progress); textured test scene; evaluator measures trajectory with the same instrument on source and render; criterion pre-registered in RT-V2-02_PREREGISTERED_CRITERION.json before rendering.
